home.workLead: Most of it is internal software with no public URL, so each case is carried by its screenshots, its context, and what it had to solve.
home.collectionsLead: The work splits cleanly by what was broken before it existed.
home.systemsBlurb: Sales tracking, expiry control, centralised auth, telephony reporting, commission lookup — production software for a pharmacy network.
home.infraBlurb: A monitoring command centre, browser SSH, ops bots, and installers that keep several hundred machines to one standard.
home.autoBlurb: Bots, image pipelines, and data assistants that take the repetitive part of a shift and do it without asking.
home.flowLead: I build with AI, but nothing reaches production on a draft alone. Every step below has to pass before the next one starts, and three of them can send the work back.
home.flowLoop: Fails here and the work goes back
home.contactLead: A system, an integration, an automation — tell me what breaks today and I will tell you honestly whether I can fix it.

projects.title: Work
projects.lead: Most of these are running inside a pharmacy network right now. Open any one for the case behind it.

collections.systemsLead: Software running in production inside Farmácias Estrela. There is no public link to any of it, so the screenshots do the talking.
collections.infraLead: Servers, networks, monitoring, and the automation that keeps a distributed operation standing up on a Monday morning.
collections.autoLead: The work that used to be done by hand every day, and now is not.

about.title: About
about.lead: I am {{age}}, based in Cascavel, and I have spent the last few years building the software a pharmacy network depends on to open its doors each morning.
about.photoAlt: Gabriel Henrique Dagostim in a data centre
about.recordLead: Work and study, in the order they happened. It starts with an Arduino.
about.howBody: I want to understand the process before I write anything. Where is the bottleneck, who feels it, and what does the person do on either side of it. The code comes after that, and it is usually smaller than expected.
about.cvLead: The same record as a PDF, in whichever language suits you.

contact.responseNote: I read everything and usually answer within a day.
